title: Business or vendor invoice
summary: An invoice or vendor request changes payment details or demands urgent settlement.
scenario: The request may exploit a real business relationship while redirecting payment.
warning_signs: Reply address or attachment differs from normal
safe_actions: Verify changed payment details using a known contact
Do not reply with confidential information
Hold payment until the change is confirmed
recovery_guidance: Contact the bank or payment provider promptly if paid
Preserve the invoice, headers, and approval trail
reporting_guidance: Use organizational reporting procedures opened independently
Keep evidence without forwarding malicious attachments
prevention_tips: Use dual approval for changed payment instructions
false_positive_notes: Vendors can change accounts, but a second-channel confirmation is reasonable.
